text: Hello. My boyfriend is Israeli, and we are applying for a spousal reunification visa. They are asking for a certificate of single status for me, but such a document does not exist in France. We submitted an affidavit prepared with a lawyer in Israel, but after submitting the application, they are asking for the certificate of single status again. I was wondering if you had gone through this process and if you had any information on how to handle this requirement? Thank you in advance for your reply.
